name: /brief
description: Quick status check - current state and priorities

steps.description: Run the project-local brief helper through the shared launcher; pass arguments separately, never interpolate shell text.

steps.command: Based on the status scan, provide a concise 3-bullet summary: 1) Current priority/focus, 2) Any immediate blockers or interrupts, 3) Quick wins available. Keep it actionable and under 30 words total. Read brief_work.py context when available; use the selected task as the focus and flag selection-required as a blocker. /brief stays a read-only status command; task creation and revision belong to /brief-work.

options: Ready - run '/work' to start deep context
